inlines.v: ADESSENA'RIANS, noun [Latin adesse, to be present.] In church history, a sect who hold the real presence of Christ's body in the eucharist, but not by transubstantiation. They differ however as to this presence; some holding the body of Christ to be in the bread; others, about the bread.
